title: prunus persica var. xanthocarpa
intro: Prunus persica var. xanthocarpa, commonly known as yellow peach, is a variety of peach tree that is native to China. This plant is known for its rich content of vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants, which provide numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease, cancer, and neurodegenerative disorders. The therapeutic actions of Prunus persica var. xanthocarpa include anti-diarrheal, anti-flatulent, and anti-inflammatory effects, which have been traditionally used to treat gastrointestinal issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
